# dtcloud_ssh_keys (Data Source)

Lists the SSH keys on the account.

The list endpoint reports a name and a creation time, and nothing else. Fingerprints and public keys
would mean one more call per key, so look a key up with `dtcloud_ssh_key` when you need those.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_ssh_keys" "all" {}

output "key_names" {
  value = data.dtcloud_ssh_keys.all.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `names` (List of String) Just the names, for the common case of checking whether a key exists.
- `ssh_keys` (List of Object) The SSH keys visible to the caller. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_keys))
